title.en: sunday flea market at the mauerpark.

line.en: the stalls run every sunday from 10:00 to 18:00. bring cash, and come early for the better boxes.
line.de: die stände sind jeden sonntag von 10 bis 18 uhr offen. bargeld mitnehmen und für die besseren kisten früh kommen.
line.tr: tezgahlar her pazar 10:00 ile 18:00 arası açık. nakit al, iyi kutular için erken gel.

sparks.why: The Mauerpark flea market runs every Sunday 10:00 to 18:00 per Berlin flea-market listings (in-berlin-brandenburg.com); the November date was not checked one by one.
